address: 285 rue Charlet-Straton, à Argentière, Chamonix Mont-Blanc, 74400, France
bio: Built in the 1860s, this imposing building near the Swiss border has accommodated a hotel for over 160 years. It has since been nicely refurbished, while retaining its name. A young local chef cooks up appetising dishes that pay homage to the terroir: courgette tartare, soft-boiled egg, faisselle mousse; pork, polenta, Alpine harissa. At lunchtime, there is a simpler set menu. The pleasant terrace affords a view of the mountains....
